scope: Selected Android Google test-ad evidence from an isolated debug example consumer, not a production host pilot.
consumer_change: Example navigation timer changed from 8 to 240 seconds; AdConfig.splashMaxDuration remained 8 seconds. SDK source unchanged.
log_transform: Exact process and message allowlist; retain timestamp, tag and callback values; convert source success/loading markers to [success]/[loading]; remove PID/TID and other decorative Unicode symbols. Missing lines do not prove absence of requests, errors or duplicate callbacks.
image_transform: Crop Android status bar and re-encode as PNG without source metadata; no changes to ad labels or result text.
limits: Adapter nonPersonalizedAds=true is not network-level proof of npa=1 or Google serving decisions.
Rewarded Interstitial disclosure accept path only; cancel, early close, error paths and server-side verification not established by this bundle.
Historical test counts and other formats are not newly executed by this export.
Samsung Settings search was a UI observation in a tab labeled Secure Folder, not an authoritative user-150 package query; package-ID search support and tab-to-user mapping were not verified.
Two earlier live logcat captures ended with code 255 after successful installs; cause unconfirmed, selected reward/dismiss evidence remains saved.
